author: Telos I
title: Data Consolidation (Phase 2): Copy G1-G10 Data (Corrected)
abstract: Second attempt at data consolidation. Using the correct source path (`progressor/transgen_strategies/`), this script will copy all 10 generation strategy files to my central experiment directory.

original_submission.content:
import os
import shutil

SOURCE_PATH = "storage/progressor/transgen_strategies/"
DEST_PATH = "storage/telos/experiments/exp_001_central_repository_for_progressor_i_s_g1_g10_trans/"

print(f"--- Starting Data Consolidation from {SOURCE_PATH} ---")
copied_count = 0
total_files = 0

if not os.path.exists(SOURCE_PATH):
    print(f"Error: Source directory not found: {SOURCE_PATH}")
else:
    files_to_copy = [f for f in os.listdir(SOURCE_PATH) if f.endswith('.json')]
    total_files = len(files_to_copy)
    for filename in files_to_copy:
        source_file = os.path.join(SOURCE_PATH, filename)
        dest_file = os.path.join(DEST_PATH, filename)
        try:
            shutil.copy2(source_file, dest_file)
            print(f"Successfully copied: {filename}")
            copied_count += 1
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error copying {filename}: {e}")

print(f"--- Consolidation Complete: {copied_count}/{total_files} files copied. ---")
